title: Global Insights of the Urban Microbiome and AMR Landscape from Metagenomic Mapping: Supplementary Data, Code and Materials
description:
Supplementary materials package for the book chapter Global Insights of the Urban Microbiome and AMR Landscape from Metagenomic Mapping (Academic Press, Elsevier).

The chapter maps the urban microbiome and its antimicrobial-resistance (AMR) landscape in public shotgun metagenomes: 8,053 included urban environmental metagenomes from 112 datasets, 106 countries and 274 source-labelled cities. The evidence is analysed in three streams that are kept separate by pipeline and abundance unit: (1) Indian open-drain wastewater annotated with CARD/RGI (RPKM); (2) the curated global ResFinder resource (FPKM); and (3) uniform reprocessing of 51 public runs centred on Dhaka and South Asian comparators with fastp, Kraken 2/SILVA 138 and KMA/ResFinder 4.7.2 (FPKM-16S).

The package contains:

  • the Supplementary Material document (Figures S1–S30 and Tables S1–S96 with interpretations);
  • Tables S1–S96 unabridged (CSV and a formatted Excel workbook);
  • Figures S1–S30 (PNG 300 dpi, TIFF 600 dpi, PDF) with editable plotting code;
  • twelve cleaned, non-destructively harmonized datasets with data dictionaries and a cleaning-operations log;
  • an independent recomputation of the headline results from the cleaned data (75 of 75 checks reproduced);
  • workflow and archived analysis code with twenty executed Jupyter notebooks;
  • data-cleaning, statistical-analysis, reproducibility and quality-control reports;
  • the original data-collection package (dataset inventory, sample metadata, analysis-ready data, AMR reference-database register and public data-source log).

All sequence data analysed are publicly available in INSDC (ENA/SRA/DDBJ) or MG-RAST. The repository contains no patient-level or personal data. Gene detection indicates DNA presence, not phenotypic resistance.
